# Second opinion inside T3 Code

Read the shared [T3 dispatch and lifecycle rules](../../helix/references/t3.md).
They cover discovery, exact targets, permissions, inheritance, isolation and
completion. Do not run the Helix implementation workflow for a consultation.

Use one fresh `delegate_task` with a self-contained review question. Keep the
consultant read-only and do not let it delegate. Use shared isolation when it
needs uncommitted files; a separate worktree starts from the last commit.

If the requested provider, model, effort or required isolation cannot be applied,
return **NOT RUN** with the missing capability. Do not substitute a model.
A completed task is not evidence of agreement or a useful answer.

A later independent consultation needs a new task and request ID. Messaging an
old child can continue its conversation and does not establish independence.
